faqs.a: SimpLeads is a lead intelligence and qualification platform that helps you find people and companies, identify Active Job Signals, qualify leads and prioritize which prospects deserve attention.

faqs.q: What is the five-step SimpLeads pipeline?
faqs.a: The core pipeline has exactly five stages: People → Company → Jobs → Scoring → Export. Google Maps, Instagram, YouTube, B2B Directory and Investor Data are separate discovery tools, not additional stages of the core pipeline.

faqs.q: How is SimpLeads different from a normal lead generation tool?
faqs.a: Traditional lead generation primarily focuses on finding contacts. SimpLeads adds company context, Active Job Signals and AI Lead Qualification to help determine which contacts should be prioritized.

faqs.q: What does AI Lead Qualification evaluate?
faqs.a: The qualification framework considers available information across Need, Urgency, Relevance and Authority. It is designed to help prioritize opportunities rather than simply generate a larger contact list.

SimpLeads is being developed toward broader BANT-style qualification. Need, Authority and timing/urgency can be part of the qualification framework, while Budget / financial qualification is currently in development.

Active Job Signals use recent job activity as a business-intelligence signal. Hiring activity can provide useful context about a company’s expansion or changing needs, but it does not guarantee buying intent.
Yes. SimpLeads includes a separate Google Maps Search tool for discovering local businesses using keywords and location.

faqs.q: Can I search Instagram, YouTube and B2B directories?
faqs.a: Yes. SimpLeads includes separate discovery tools for Instagram, YouTube and supported B2B directories, including IndiaMART and Yellow Pages.
The current export options include Full Bundle, Summary CSV, Leads Only and Jobs Only.
SimpLeads is currently in public beta. Some features are experimental, and AI-generated content may occasionally make mistakes.
